answer: An adversary running 66 aliases thus needs 109 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are entered in pigment, expire in terrace, and whisper lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 17 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1185 identities would post 3376 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
